newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates end up on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates end up on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's overnight money market rates soared to 20 percent at close on Wednesday from Tuesday's 4.00 percent in a shortage of funds after a central bank open market operation picked up some 7.3 billion rupees from the banking system, dealers said.
The rates opened at 15 percent and jumped to 20 percent when the central bank announced the operation's result, one dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank in Karachi said.
The market was short of funds and discounting of some three billion rupees was also reported, the dealer said.
